title: Concept: Pipfile source configured over cleartext
description: Pipfile declares a Pipfile source URL that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Artifacts and hashes travel unencrypted, so a network attacker can replace the package and the hash that verifies it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Pipfile (pypi).
risk: Artifacts and hashes travel unencrypted, so a network attacker can replace the package and the hash that verifies it.
